item.title: Israel expands travel warnings to Armenia, Georgia and Azerbaijan
item.description: The National Security Council urges Israelis to avoid travel to three additional countries and warns of heightened Iranian efforts to target Israelis and Jews abroad since the launch of Operation Roaring Lion

item.title: Macron urges Iran to halt regional attacks as Israel strikes IRGC air force headquarters in Tehran
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron calls on Tehran to stop attacks and reopen the Strait of Hormuz as the IDF says it destroyed the IRGC air force headquarters in Tehran, a key command center for Iran’s missiles and drones

item.title: 'Proud to lead on International Women’s Day': female IDF officers on front lines of war with Iran
item.description: IDF says thousands of women are leading operational efforts on the front lines and home front in the war with Iran; 'My soldiers and I will remain here as long as needed to protect Israel and its citizens,' says the navy’s first female missile ship commander

item.title: IDF chief: ‘This war will be much longer, but it will shape our future for years’; Sirens across central, southern Israel
item.description: Air defenses intercept missiles launched from Iran as the IDF says it killed the chief aide to the future supreme leader in Tehran and continued strikes on Hezbollah targets in Lebanon

item.title: Students in southern Israel clean and prepare missile shelters, aid elderly during war
item.description: Students from the Ayalim Association’s student villages in Beersheba, Dimona and Sderot have joined local emergency efforts since start of Operation Roaring Lion against Iran

item.title: IDF sees chance to dismantle Hezbollah as Israel detects ‘near-total disconnect’ with Iran
item.description: ‘Hezbollah joined the fighting as anticipated,’ IDF officials say; Northern Command aims to push the terror group north and avoid evacuations as strikes on Iran and Lebanon create what the military calls a rare opportunity to finish it

item.title: Black rain falls in Tehran after Israeli strikes oil facilities: 'Hardest night since war began'
item.description: Thick black smoke blankets Tehran after Israeli strikes on fuel storage sites used by Iran’s military; CNN footage shows rainwater mixed with oil pooling on streets, while residents tell BBC Persian it was the worst night since the conflict began

item.title: Air raid sirens sound throughout southern, central Israel following launch from Iran
item.description: Missiles successfully intercepted; comes hours after sirens sent millions of residents of northern Israel, Sharon region to bomb shelters; IDF to hold military exercise in Golan Heights area

item.title: There is a war going on but the shopping centers are full: 'People are looking for some fresh air'
item.description: Israelis took advantage of the easing of safety guidelines and the decrease in the rate of launches from Iran, and went out to have fun despite the warning sirens; 'There’s early warning, and you can reach a protected space anywhere; It gives you room to breathe and live'

item.title: Missile barrages and national determination: The signs that the conflict could continue for some time
item.description: Nine days into the Israel–U.S. offensive on Iran, missile launches are declining but the war shows no sign of ending; Hezbollah has escalated attacks from Lebanon as Washington deploys more forces and leaders signal a long campaign ahead
